description: Two channels of random-walk CV, drawn as an X/Y trace on the display

params.text: How fast and how far that channel's voltage wanders
Adds or subtracts up to 5V from that channel's output
Attenuates that channel's output, from full level down to nothing
JUMP throws both channels to a new random value on each trigger; S&H samples and holds them instead; T&H passes the generator through while the gate is high and holds when it drops

inputs.text: A CV over that channel's offset, 5V either way, attenuverted by its knob
A 0-10V CV over that channel's scale, attenuated by its knob
A 0-10V CV over how fast that channel wanders, attenuated by its knob
A trigger or gate here acts on both channels in whichever way the selector is set to

outputs.text: That channel's random walk, 5V either way, after its own scale and offset
A third CV, 0-10V, derived from the other two

notes: clicking or dragging the display drives the outputs directly
menu: Display range — the voltage the display covers, +/-5V or +/-10V
Show grid — draws the grid dots on the display
Trace color — the colour of the trace: Green, Orange, Red or Blue

inputs.6: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
